question:
For the customer who paid 634.8 in 2012/8/25, what was the consumption decrease rate from Year 2012 to 2013?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: '2012/8/24' can be represented by '2012-08-24'; Consumption decrease rate = (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012

prediction.sql:
SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM yearmonth ym
WHERE ym.XCL_019 = (SELECT t.XCL_013 FROM transactions_1k t WHERE t.XCL_018 = 634.8 AND t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-25')
